name: Response Quality
description: Judges a response against a quality profile: a named set of criteria with weights and target values. The profile is resolved for each request from the Representative, Guidance and Prioritization, and falls back to a default profile. Each arm judges one criterion and can also repair: links held to the evidence, figures held to the evidence, no em dash, and day counts that match the calendar.
purpose: Judge a response against the quality profile that applies to this request.
approach: Resolve the profile, judge each criterion, and report one balanced score per profile.
out_of_scope: A person's own profile (Representatives own that), context-specific criteria (Guidance owns those), translating implied priorities into weights (Prioritization owns that), updating a profile from feedback (Feedback Learning owns that) and whether the goal was met (Goal Completion).
milestones: 1. One balanced score for each quality profile, with the weights and targets of the profile fixed before any method is scored (authoritative metric metric-response-quality).
measures_of_success: One balanced score for each quality profile, with the weights and targets of the profile fixed before any method is scored.
inputs: A response, the evidence behind it and the resolved quality profile (the default profile when none is given).
outputs: The findings against each criterion of the profile; an empty list means the response held.
effects: Reads and writes nothing itself: it calls the entry points of the parts it uses.
usage_notes: Each arm judges one criterion; the other criteria of the default profile have no arm yet. A consumer that wants a repair rather than a verdict imports the arm's functions by name from hubofhubs.api (remove_em_dashes, strip_unsupported, evidence_of, day_count_errors, relativize).
